newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends little changed vs US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends little changed vs US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed little changed at 8.2965 against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday from Tuesday's 8.2963 due to intervention from the central bank, traders said.
The weighted average price on Tuesday was 8.2966.
The yuan opened almost unchanged at 8.2965 and hardly moved in early trading.
It then fluctuated in a wider range, hitting an intraday high of 8.2909 and a low of 8.3016 mid-session before stabilising again around 8.2965 towards the close.
Trading was more active than on Tuesday with most business done at about 8.2965, traders said.
Dealers said significant buying by a Chinese bank around the mid-session made the yuan fluctuate widely for a period. They declined to name the bank.
The People's Bank of China, the central bank, then intervened, selling the local currency to bring the yuan's movements back into a narrow range, they said.
"Intervention by the central bank prevented the yuan from rising in late trading," a dealer said.
Dealers said some designated banks followed the central bank's lead in selling yuan.
Despite Wednesday's wide movements, traders said they expected the yuan to move in a narrow range over the next few days.
The yuan is likely to move around the 8.2970 level on Thursday, they said.
The yuan closed up at 6.5700 from 6.6000 against 100 Japanese yen and higher at 1.0700 from 1.0713 against the Hong Kong dollar.
